rounds.notes:
### General Notes


We start with [Hidden Blade](item_a820416d-85e5-4018-b20a-dc1cbf744900) as our first power and buy [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) as our first two items. These are non-negotiable. 

[Hidden Blade](item_a820416d-85e5-4018-b20a-dc1cbf744900) gives 15 extra quick melee damage, for a total of 55 damage, plus 60% melee lifesteal. NOTE - the lifesteal is MELEE LIFESTEAL, not QUICK melee lifesteal. [Dragonblade](ability_eacd2edc-6723-45e0-993c-1647828c5069) is [Melee Damage](stat_melee_damage), but not quick melee damage. Blade now has 60% lifesteal but the damage is not buffed by any of your items yet. 
[Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) gives 25 health every time you land a quick melee. (55x0.60)+25= **58 ** health after back every single melee you land.
We take [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) instead of damage items because it's because the opportunity cost of picking something else is just too high. Our first green health item increases our max health by 10% and our second increases it by another 9%. Early on they are the single biggest buff you can get, especially with armor's extra damage mitigation.

ON SOMEONE OTHER THAN GENJI, like [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), an argument can be made that [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) and [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) alongside a single green health item is better because it lets you farm more damage and that gives you more money in round 2, but you're playing a melee Genji build early on and you are going to want ever bit of health you can get instead. 
*See below for why*

---
### In Your Ranked Games

Ranked is inherently deathmatch-y, where it is hard to rely on your teammates. Sometimes things are sick and they're awesome, sometimes you think they feed and thy think you feed. It's just an unfortunate facet of the game. Therefore, your goal is to be self-sufficient at the start. Play to live, but know that you have the advantage in any 1v1 against a squishy. Each quick melee is healing you for almost 60 health and hitting them for 55 damage. That healing is also great against any tank duel but isn't quite enough to win on your own in an isolated 1v1. [Winston's](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88) primary fire, for example, deals 70 damage per second. Quick melee goes off once per second. Just by melee spamming against Winston, you're taking almost no damage.
Generally, you poke from within dash range until someone is low, then dash + right click + melee. 


---
### In the [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88), [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), and [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) OR [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) Dive Comp

Genji does not initiate much in the first couple rounds. Soldier 76's [Double Helix](item_808afc07-1398-4962-bf2c-f8e3b74014e3) is frequently the "go button" so to speak, where it does enough burst damage that a quick follow-up dash can be enough to delete someone. Otherwise, there is not much of a difference in gameplay between ranked and coordinated play beyond the... *coordination * part. As the match progresses, Stadium gets further from "normal" Overwatch and you'll see a bigger difference in your role as the Genji.

More on the strategy of our comp as you read through the round notes (:

### In General

If you can afford it, buying [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) is the best choice IF you can do so without selling [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7). I want to drive some attention toward [aykira's build](https://stadiumbuilds.io/build/d30baf3b-69ba-456b-9092-c01577c0a53f) where he does all the calculations so I'm not going to shamelessly copy-and-paste them here, but it bumps up your heal on quick melee to almost 80 health. HOWEVER, that does not happen often so we gotta be realistic. 

If you don't have the 13k needed for [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7), [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6), and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), we build survival in the next best way - green items.

First, we keep [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), and start adding IN ORDER [Adrenaline Shot](item_ab8eba6a-0bda-4b12-8854-4ba4169b515f), then [Winning Attitude](item_8714087c-c078-4619-a2ef-327bc6edaa69), then [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da). If you enough have extra cash left over for [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2), great. Buy it for a little but of extra damage. If you don't, no sweat. [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) is your final pickup if you can just for a little bit of damage. 

Some might pick up [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) as a final 1k, but let's be honest with ourselves, if we're really poor we probably aren't building blade fast and having the extra stats for one fight often isn't worth it.

---
### [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88), [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), and [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) OR [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) Dive

If your team is crushing it and there is an easily exploitable dive target, like a [Zenyatta](hero_3c4002ee-e694-48ed-9730-70fd48773317) on a team that struggles to peel for him, but you still don't have the 13k for [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7), [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6), and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), it can sometimes be worth it to buy [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a). Then build out green health items like above and only buy one or two. If you're just short of being able to afford another green health item, dropping down to [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) to afford it is absolutely worthwhile. If you have to go cheaper than [Icy Coolant](item_8b1c21e9-33e8-49a6-8277-a3a06d55a65f) to spend all your money, just buy greens like above.

I only recommend the [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) route in organized gameplay because the risk of sacrificing survivability in the chaos of ranked is not worth it.

### In General

Our power pickup this round is [Iaido Strike](item_0b4def91-53c9-4bb7-b706-05aff6e4b168). it turns our deflect into a damage ability that also heals us for 60% of its damage. It's now difficulty to lose an isolated 1v1 if you have your cooldowns. 

For items, there are a couple of options. If you're rich, ideally you buy [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) for more damage in your burst. When you're at 5 stacks, you get a whopping 35% extra damage on your blade swings, making each use of your deflect a massive heal from the swing after and makes that swing likely to kill the squishy you hit. It can also catch tanks by surprise, hitting them for an unexpected amount of damage. Superflexor also makes you difficult to kill during [Dragonblade](ability_eacd2edc-6723-45e0-993c-1647828c5069) because you're getting healed for close to one-third of your health each swing. 

If you find yourself getting poked out before you can close the distance for your deflect swing, [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) can help sustain through the poke phase when you can't get a melee off. It also helps against burst damage characters like [Freja](hero_e80840a1-845d-4008-966c-585b7cb4a424) or [Cassidy](hero_3dd63854-7558-4344-86e4-b506f807129b) if you can build up the 100 overhealth before you commit. 

If you can't afford to keep [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) AND buy [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) or [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) without selling your [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) and [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7), don't buy them. Like last round, fill out slots with [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and green health items. 


---
### Flex Items 

This is the first round I can justify [Anti-Beam Coating](item_1ab73e1c-aaa1-4026-89cd-68404db7fd93) if they have multiple beam heroes (Zarya AND Moira, for example). If there is only one beam hero on the other team, it is usually better to play around them instead of spending 4k just to counter one hero for a couple seconds in your deflect. [Anti-Beam Coating](item_1ab73e1c-aaa1-4026-89cd-68404db7fd93) is not worth buying in Round 2 because there should not be enough damage scaling on the other team's beam heroes to overpower your melee heal and before you can dash out.


---
### In the Dive Comp

Buy [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) and NOT [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643). With multiple people hitting the same target, increasing your burst damage is far, far more important. Your survivability now comes from killing them before they can kill you or stalling for time with melee heals and your deflect until you get help from your team.

### In General

Welcome to the most awkward round of the build. often times you are not rich enough for the [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) pivot, so we build some more survival unless we hit ~37k and then you can skip to Round 5 and build it there. The power from Round 5 helps with consistency but not peak damage, so it's totally fine to pivot now if you are rich.


If you aren't having the perfect game, you might not have enough. In that case, build some more [Weapon Power](stat_weapon_power) if you don't need hero-specific counter items. [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) is a perfectly valid option here if you aren't quite at the 37k cutoff because you will live longer and still get some extra damage out of it.


---

### [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88), [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), and [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) OR [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) Dive

This is also an awkward round depending on your money. Follow the same plan as above and stack more weapon power and be just a lil sad about it :))

### In General

Welcome to the burst blade pivot. With [Hashimoto's Bane](item_03650ff3-917e-45fe-aeed-11c0f24c0eba) you get a far more reliable proc of our two new items: [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) and [Three-Tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429). The plan is to close the distance WITHOUT using dash or deflect. Once you're at 5 stacks of [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b), you deflect to swing your blade (canceling your deflect early by pressing the keybind again if there is no real damage you need to stop to speed up the combo). Right click now homes in on the enemy and hits hard with Kitsune and Three-Tap. Dash through them, which is finally scaling thanks to our new [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) pivot, and right click again.

---

### In [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88), [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), and [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) OR [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) Dive

Little is different from here on out between ranked and the "organized teamplay" playstyle. the combos are the same, only the coordination of both teams is different.

rounds.notes:
### In General

[Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) is a useful pickup here, our damage is strong enough that some extra survival outweighs the benefit of extra damage. We'll be doing the same thing next round, where we build survivability instead of increasing damage.

---

### [Winston](hero_a0ebe5ef-69a6-4a8f-9360-7b7fed8bce88), [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546), [Genji](hero_31fd201d-2f46-41e4-b125-9fa9e55fed46), [Moira](hero_7fb6ff1e-a193-40c0-bd0a-25c1928fbaed), and [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) OR [Lucio](hero_b38c5d54-a585-4545-b0b8-4d4b205b3768) Dive



If you are running a [Kiriko](hero_70a0ac5c-2a55-4fab-beeb-2f570886426f) and they picked up [Cleansing Charge](item_4721f307-30d2-4fc1-a10b-6de7141deb68), buying [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) so they can cleanse the damage over time and get extra ultimate charge often outweighs the positives from [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) and should be prioritized.

---

### Flex Items

Sometimes if my blades are not getting shut down I'll get [Transference Delta](item_4bcdd047-90a2-43af-8d57-160cb21022ee) to build them faster. This is an ego choice, so you better be able to back it up.

If there is a lot of damage over time (like Ashe dynamite) or beam characters,  [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) is a great counter because stacks build on damage sources that proc often.

rounds.notes:
### Woo final round! Go and win this!

Continue to buy the survival items from last round, starting with either [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) or [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643), whichever you didn't get. 

If the enemy doesn't have a good way to build stacks of [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d), go wild and get [Transference Delta](item_4bcdd047-90a2-43af-8d57-160cb21022ee)
